summary: EQT Infrastructure Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of equity securities and a transactional NAV update. On July 20, 2026, the company sold 3,931,506 shares across multiple classes for ~$106M cash, at NAV-based prices ranging from ~$26.12 to $28.48 per share. Since inception, it has sold ~$818M in its continuous private offering. The sale is exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Reg D/S. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
